summary: Map kit: draw creatures on the parchment monster areas
author: pm
body:
Goal: draw the creatures on the parchment monster areas (user, 2026-11-24). build_kit.py replaces the sword icon of a monster area that has creature art with up to 3 creature icons (frames added to icons.json as creature_<name>, sheet creatures.png), one shared scale clamped to a min and max on-kit height. Areas without creature art keep the sword. No client change: parchment_kit.cpp already loads any icons.json frame and its sheet.

Done when: the kit is rebuilt, every monster area with creature art shows creatures instead of the sword, ink PNGs are unchanged, and previews of middleland, huntzone1 and a dungeon map (300 and 1200) were checked by eye.
